t13422:
Bell compliments me no matter what I wear,
but does that mean there are outfits he doesn't like?
Like, "Goddess, that outfit's a little..."
GAH, just imagining it does damage!
t13423: Q: How are you feeling right now?
t13424:
Right now I'm just overflowing with gratitude!
But the Hestia Familia's winning streak
isn't stopping here, not by a long shot.
I'll give it my all with everyone! Hooray!
t13425: Q: About the Holy Night Festival
t13426:
Exchanging presents, couples getting all cozy... It's a really lovely mortal-world tradition.
I'm gonna ride this big wave with Bell, all the way to new heights!!
t13427: Q: What gift would make you happy?
t13428:
The gift that made me happiest so far... the hair ornament Bell gave me, I guess?
When I got it, I thought from the bottom of my heart how glad I was to have met him, and that he was my very first familia member.
t13429: Q: Is your part-time job tough?
t13430:
I'm used to being busy, but on Holy Night tons of lovey-dovey couples come to buy Jyaga Maru-kun.
I'm jealous, or, like, I wanna hold hands with Bell and go on a date like that too...
t13432:
I do.
Watching my familia gather around the fireplace for warmth... As goddess of the hearth, it just warms my heart.
t13433: Q: Who do you want to give a gift to?
t13434:
Do you even need to ask?
I put on this outfit to give Bell the best surprise ever!
Ehehe, ehehe~... Bell... I wonder if he'll like it.
t13435:
Whaaat?! Cute? I mean, that's...!
Well, how do I put it, everyone's so charming...
Um, so... Waaaaah!
I can't answer that, I'm sorry~!
t13436:
Someone at Lv. 100 must have
all kinds of special moves!
Like... Giga Burn Blast!
Or Heaven-Cleaving Overlord Sword! How's that?!
t13438:
Welf is a friend I respect, and a comrade.
The gear he made for me is
super easy to use. It's my treasure!
It's just the weapon names that are a bit...
t13439:
The goddess seems to be out today,
so I think I'll clean up our home.
If I get the walls and floors sparkling
and she's happy, that'd make me happy!
t13440: Q: Something scary that happened lately
t13441:
Sometimes I have plans even I don't know about...
Like recently, I ended up washing dishes
at The Benevolent Mistress in Syr's place.
That was a little scary...
t13442:
Ain't it obvious? It's Ais-tan!
Look all over Orario, ya won't find anyone
cooler than my Ais-tan.
If I say so, it's gotta be true!
t13443:
No pretty ladies or cute girls? No way!
I can't even imagine somethin' like that...!
If the whole familia was like Gareth...
I mean, c'mon! That'd be insane, right?!
t13445:
Ais-tan's my special favorite!
She's perfect from every angle.
But her guard's so tight... I can't even touch her.
I still ain't givin' up, nope, never!
t13447:
They won't drink with me 'cause
"Loki's a bad drunk." Ain't that cruel?
Sippin' alone has its charm too, but
if nobody drinks with me I get lo-o-onely!
t13449:
Runnin' a familia costs a lotta money.
It ain't a game, so moneymakin' schemes matter.
If I slip up, even my booze budget's in danger!
If ya hear of anything, lemme know, 'kay?
t13450:
The concept is "Blow the heat away!"
So I didn't make it all cheap and tiny,
I built it BIG!
That way the dreams and the word of mouth spread!
t13451:
Been so busy I ain't had enough to drink.
I wanted a cup with cute girls as my side dish...
Wait, it ain't too late yet!
I'm off to go see Ais-tan!
t13452:
Heh heh, lookin' pretty sharp, right?
It's my one-of-a-kind swimsuit,
custom-made just for Summerland!
No way I'm losin' to Shorty in this!
t13453: Q: Why did you build Summerland?
t13454:
Well, 'cause I can't just leave my
familia sufferin' in the heat, obviously!
Ahh, what a caring goddess I am~
...Well, there's a real reason too, guh-heh-heh.
t13456:
This is super important, so I'll whisper...
Got any real good ideas for how
I can touch Ais-tan's soft skin?
If ya do, tell me! Look, I'm beggin' ya!
t13457:
M-Ms. Ais, I guess?
The first time I met her left such an impression...
and I just haven't been able to look away since.
Oh, b-but I'm not watching her all the time!
t13458:
Lady Hestia is my only goddess,
so I don't want to switch to anyone else.
No matter what happens,
I want to stay in her familia forever!
t13459:
Lili is an irreplaceable comrade
who supports me, inexperienced as I am.
Meeting her, and still adventuring together...
I'm truly glad for all of it.
t13460: Q: Something that surprised you lately
t13461:
I saw it...
Lili had her face buried in my clothes,
and when I looked closer, she was sniffing them!
...Um, d-do I smell?
t13462: Q: Something you can't help thinking about
t13463:
"O raging crimson flame, come like thunder!
Run toward heroism! Firebolt!"
...I've been trying to come up with a chant.
Chants are just so cool, you know?
t13464:
Heh, let's see...
He's a weak, unreliable... adventurer.
And yet he shines as dazzlingly as a jewel.
I truly look forward to what comes next.
t13465:
I love my familia.
My devoted followers are adorable.
I couldn't care less about the other familias.
Oh, with one exception, of course. Heh.
t13467:
My Ottar is very capable and dependable.
He can be a little inflexible,
but I like that about him too.
It makes teasing him such fun.
t13468: Q: What's been on your mind lately
t13469:
What's on my mind... Ufufu.
Forgive me... I was just remembering something.
Oh, there is something I think about day and night.
I'll tell you... once you've satisfied me.
t13470: Q: About the things you love
t13471:
Burning hot enough to scorch my very body...
Don't you think that's wonderful?
Passion clashing with passion, sublimating...
There's no pleasure in the world that compares.
t13472: Q: What do you want most right now?
t13473:
A clear... transparent soul.
...If I could have that boy, I'd even become something too hideous to behold.
Because he is my... something nothing could ever replace.
t13475:
Each and every one of them is a follower I've loved...
They cherish me so much that they quarrel, or worry too much.
Heh. Even that part of them is adorable.
t13476:
When I found that child, he was just a little thing.
Now he's grown so big... and his beautiful soul shines all the brighter.
I pray that one day he conquers even the darkness of his past and reaches the summit he seeks.
t13478:
That shop where anyone can eat with a smile, no matter what, made by "the first woman who ever punched me."
To "my daughter," it may be a truly precious place that nothing could replace.
t13479:
About the very first "Syr"... the one before I took her name? I thought she was a very greedy girl.
She looked a goddess in the eye and said, "I want to become you."
Heh. No one had ever said such a thing to me before. It was amusing.
t13480:
Well, I'm a god after all.
I think my own followers are the cutest.
Though some of them grow up so splendidly
that they go from cute to cool. Heh.
t13481:
I'd guess they have an indomitable spirit.
No matter how strong their power or magic,
it means little if the wielder's spirit is weak.
Or maybe they have someone supporting them.
t13483:
How to put it... she's never boring to be around?
In good ways and bad... ahaha.
Even so, she's a dear divine friend to me.
She's always been right there by my side.
t13485:
A blacksmith's day? Nothing unusual.
I check and adjust my tools and materials,
then forge, and adjust again until I'm satisfied.
Though if I'm not, it can take weeks.
t13487:
I'm not particular, you know?
I just like clothes that are easy to move in.
I'll wear a dress for formal occasions,
but it doesn't suit me much, so only now and then.
t13488:
No one in particular, but let's see...
Pride in your heart, ideals in your head, hammer in hand,
facing the forge in pursuit of the very best...
That kind of attitude might be cool.
t13489:
Hmm, nothing comes to mind right away.
If I had to say, a familia that's careless
with gear a smith poured their heart into.
Not that I'd sell to a familia like that.
t13490:
He's a stubborn boy, especially about smithing.
He has complicated circumstances,
so I do worry about him a bit...
But I believe Welf will be all right.
t13491: Q: How is Hestia doing at work?
t13492:
Well, the customers seem to like her.
She's cute and friendly, maybe that's why.
I was a little surprised she never skips work.
...That boy must really mean a lot to her.
t13494:
Not much, I'd say? ...Ah, but
it gets a bit busy during big expeditions.
If they order special weapons or armor,
it's even harder... Not that I can't manage.
t13495:
Hmm, who I find cute?
...Let me see. My apologies,
I thought about it, but no one came to mind.
They're all cute, after all. Haha.
t13496:
Unimaginably strong, I'd imagine.
But that would worry me a little.
Excessive strength invites loneliness.
I'd hope they have someone to support them.
t13497:
An honest, pleasant boy.
Whenever he's near, I can't help calling out to him.
I suppose that's what they call a natural charmer.
...Hm? Why are you staring at me?
t13498: Q: Something that made you happy lately
t13499:
The other day, an acquaintance I'd given potions to
gave me a rare drop item in return.
This must be how helping hands connect,
I thought, and I was happier than a man my age should be.
t13500: Q: What you've been thinking about lately
t13501:
I happened to see Nahza lamenting
that the familia's debt never shrinks.
As her patron god, I'm pondering what I can do.
Perhaps I should start making Jyaga Maru-kun too.
t13502:
Hmm, let me see.
The coolest one around me would be Take, I suppose.
I often see him talking with women.
He's certainly popular, there's no doubt.
t13503:
I don't care for those who won't
lend a hand to people in trouble or pain.
People and gods alike should help each other out.
That's the kind of mutual support I believe in.
t13505:
She supports someone like me so steadfastly.
She's our familia's dependable captain.
It's because of her that I can be here at all.
I'm always grateful to her.
t13507:
I don't know if you'd call it a hobby, but
whenever I have time, I'm mixing medicines.
It's about all I'm good for.
It's surprisingly enjoyable, you know.
t13508: Q: Something fun that happened lately
t13509:
I'm afraid I don't have many fun stories.
I'm always in town, living the same days.
I mix medicine and give it to acquaintances, that's all.
Today I got to hand it out to many people. I'm glad.
t13510:
I'd wager every god feels this way,
but I think my followers are adorable.
I certainly do.
Mikoto, Chigusa, Ouka—I dote on them all.
t13511:
Someone with immeasurable martial prowess, surely.
If they existed, I'd want them to train
the members of my familia.
And I'd want a match with them myself.
t13512:
I'm truly sorry for the trouble
my followers caused him.
But Bell forgave them for everything.
I'm grateful, and I mean to learn from his example.
t13513:
About Mikoto, Chigusa, and Ouka...
I feel they've really grown lately.
Not just in strength, they've toughened up mentally too.
It must be all the encounters they've had.
t13515:
Hm? Ah, our familia is a small outfit too,
so I work part-time to earn whatever coin I can.
My current job even gives me Jyaga Maru-kun!
It really helps with food. Ha ha ha!
t13516:
How about Ouka?
He's quite the manly fellow, with good spirit.
What they call a "hottie," I believe?
If it's Ouka, he has my seal of approval!
t13517:
Idling, doing nothing, and sinking into sloth is no good.
Not just as a familia, but as people.
A sound mind dwells in a sound body.
Never neglect your training, no matter what.
t13519:
I've known Mikoto since she was little.
She's precious to me, one of a kind.
Very, very precious... like a daughter.
...Hm, what? Why that exasperated look?
t13521:
The dogeza... I taught it to Hestia too,
but it's not something to do lightly.
The ultimate secret art of apology and pleading...!
That is the dogeza. Don't use it casually.
t13522:
I hear Hestia's Jyaga Maru-kun stand
has been selling like crazy lately.
I can't afford to lose to her...
Today, too, I'll serve them with all my heart!
t13523:
Come on... You don't get it, you just don't get it.
Ranking cuteness is nonsense!
All women are lovely and charming!
Oh, as for you gentlemen, no idea, not interested.
t13524:
Anyone at Lv. 100 has to be a hero.
So, do you know this saying?
"Heroes love beauty"... meaning they love women.
They'd have a harem or something. I'm jealous.
t13525:
Bell is always at the center of the action,
pushing forward through hardship and trial,
like a hero you'd only hear of in stories.
And that's why I'm hooked on him.
t13527:
You've got a good eye, asking me.
It's easy. Just tell her exactly what you think.
If she plays along, success.
If she slaps you, failure... Got it?
t13528: Q: About your lack of seriousness
t13529:
...You're really asking me that to my face?
I'm a serious guy, for the record! I work!
I just rely on people a tiiiny bit much,
and take a tiiiny few detours. End of discussion!
t13530:
He draws a lot of attention,
and more than a few are drawn to him.
I'll put my vote in for Bell.
Or maybe... me! Not bad, right?
t13531:
I'll pass on anyplace that ties me down.
It's fun actually going to all sorts of places.
Seeing with my own eyes, hearing with my ears, talking...
Some things you only learn that way.
t13533:
Asfi is our dependable captain!
The reason I can do whatever I please
is all because Asfi's so capable.
I'll keep counting on her, cleanup included.
t13534:
I'm thinking it's about time for another trip.
I'm actually pretty busy, you know?
The familia... will be fine. Asfi's there.
Leave it to Asfi and nothing can go wrong!
t13536:
W-whoa, whoa... Where's this coming from?
I'm delicate, that really hurts!
And I do what I need to do, okay?!
I'm not sloppy. Definitely. Probably... Surely!
t13537: Q: What's the best part of traveling?
t13538:
Fresh scenery in unknown lands, all the delicacies along the way. Lots of encounters.
And a romance with a beauty would make for the greatest travel memory.
Ah... I'd love for Artemis and Bell to get a taste of that on this trip.
t13539: Q: Any travel memories with Asfi?
t13540:
Once on a trip, Asfi and I tried that village's specialty, "Twin Lovey-Dovey Juice"...
She turned bright red. Quite the sight.
Getting pummeled afterward included, it's a fond memory.
t13541:
Hestia... will push Bell forward no matter what.
And she'll face Artemis's feelings head-on.
She's a truly strong goddess, far more than she looks.
t13542: Q: About the journey to the Elsos Ruins
t13543:
A journey whose ending has already been decided...
Honestly... what a rotten role I've been handed.
Still, now that it's mine, I'll aim for the best outcome.
On the name of Hermes, I swear it.
t13544:
When you say Artemis, which Artemis do you mean?
Well, either way, she's a goddess worthy of respect.
Her nobility makes me... no, let's not.
I'd rather not get shot full of arrows again for having impure thoughts.
t13545:
I don't know and I don't care.
However handsome or powerful they may be,
all shall kneel before this beauty.
Shall I make you kneel as well?
t13546:
I trust no familia but my own.
What use does Orario have for some band
of fools playing at friendship?
You should live true to your desires.
t13548:
...Don't speak that woman's name, it's vile!
They fawn over her, calling her beautiful,
but not for much longer. Just you watch...
I'll smash that prim face of hers to pieces...!
t13549: Q: The secret to your beauty
t13550:
I do nothing. Gods are unchanging.
I'm beautiful simply because I always was.
If I were to offer some godly advice:
if you have to ask for the secret, give up on beauty.
t13551:
The Loki Familia, the Freya Familia...
Heh, mere second-rate familias.
I'll show all of Orario that
the Ishtar Familia stands at the top.
t13552:
Everyone laughing together without distinction,
enjoying a brief moment. It's a fine festival.
...For me, it's also where I met Orion and Hestia.
A festival nothing could replace.
t13553:
I never thought I'd ride a wyvern.
Monsters are beings to be shunned...
But there are exceptions like this.
And that surprise makes my heart dance.
t13554:
We've been together since our days in the heavens.
One of my few divine friends.
She's always bright and shares her smiles with others.
...I admire Hestia for that.
t13555: Q: Something you worked hard at on the journey
t13556:
To grow closer to Orion,
I tried, in my own way, what Hermes taught me.
I didn't understand it, but I tried,
and it wasn't bad... I think.
t13558:
Orion is my hope.
And... a curious person.
Just talking with him... no,
just being near him fills my heart with joy.
t13559:
True to the name "Vesta," she is a goddess like a sacred flame who brightens everything around her just by being there... my one and only divine friend since our days in the heavens.
I'm glad to see she's been well since descending to the mortal world.
t13561:
...!! Stop!
Do not speak that name in front of me!
Just remembering that loathsome goddess stirs a black urge from the depths of my heart...
t13563:
I want Orion... to keep smiling.
From now on. Forever.
That is the one true "wish" within me.
t13564: Q: About your journey with Orion
t13565:
A journey so delightful...
it makes me think sinful thoughts,
like wishing it would go on forever.
t13567:
Far more than the gods give him credit for...
This journey showed me he's kind, and faithful to a fault.
Truly... I'm sorry for making him carry such a heavy burden.
t13568: Q: Your outfit looks like Lefiya's?
t13569:
We just happened to get new gear around
the same time, and they ended up similar... Ahaha.
But being told I look like a strong
adventurer like Ms. Lefiya makes me happy.
t13570: Q: How does the new gear feel?
t13571:
It's as easy to move in as my old gear, or even more.
It feels just right.
It looks so cool I don't even want to scratch it!
...Not that that's possible. Haha.
t13573:
A veteran adventurer who can do anything...
That's how she looks to me.
I'd love to talk with her about all kinds of things,
...but for some reason she hates me. Ugh.
t13575:
I showed this gear to the goddess too,
and she complimented it, but...
then she warned me it's too cool,
so I should wear it as little as possible...
t13577:
Wh-who I admire...?
...Well, she's someone very far away.
But I want to chase her... to catch up to her.
I'll keep feeling that way from now on, too.
t13579:
It's a really wonderful day, isn't it?
...You mean I have that many people I like?
N-no no no, that's not what I meant!
I meant it's a nice day to show gratitude!
t13581:
Actually... I'm not great with them.
Really sweet things are a bit much for me...
So I've been making chocolate while
asking people I know to taste-test.
t13583:
Lady Demeter recommended it, saying
"This is perfect for you!"
I heard it's battle attire for cooking,
but I'm worried whether I can pull it off...
t13584: Q: Something that surprised you lately
t13585:
Lady Demeter surprised me a little.
She's funnier than I expected, or rather...
she made me think, "Ah, she really is a goddess"...
...What does "love & peace" mean, anyway?
t13587:
Since I have the chance, I want to do my best
and give out delicious chocolate.
Oh, I have a test batch. Would you like some?
If you want, here you go!
t13588:
I've been invited a few times now,
but I'm still not used to it.
But having people celebrate for me
makes me really happy!
t13589:
I'm kind of jittery... ahaha.
But strangely, it also makes me feel focused.
I guess formal wear has that effect, huh?
t13590:
Dancing with someone
is harder than it looks...
But as you get in sync, it slowly gets more and more fun! Funny how that works.
t13591: Q: Something you thought about recently
t13592:
Since coming to Orario, I sometimes
get invited to celebrations like this...
So I want to learn manners and etiquette,
even if it's little by little.
t13593:
I think being celebrated like this
is all thanks to everyone being here for me!
So I'll keep working hard
to be a help to everyone too!
t13595:
Diving into dangerous caves to grab a big dream...
Maybe it's a little like being an adventurer?
It's tough work, isn't it?
t13597:
I love this kind of excitement!
Everyone's working so hard,
just being here gives me energy.
t13599:
I can't take the goddess into the Dungeon,
so time like this feels really precious.
While we're here, I want to make
lots of memories before we head home.
t13601:
Huh... Um... well...
I think he's a very... in many ways...
handful of a god...
Ahaha...
t13602: Q: Who comes to mind when you think of gold?
t13603:
Beautiful golden hair and eyes...
I guess it'd have to be Ms. Ais?
Always shining and sparkling,
and out of reach... Ehehe.
t13605:
I want to see heroic tales on stage, of course!
"Dungeon Oratoria," obviously, and "The Adventures of Garad"... and "Cadmus and the Songstress" too!
t13606: Q: Please act out the role of a hero
t13607:
Oh... Songstress! So long as you keep singing, through fire and water, I shall fight on!
Um... sorry, I'm a terrible actor...
t13609: A great actress loved by people all over the world, and a jack-in-the-box who says one outrageous thing after another... She's my No. 1 "fave"!
t13610:
Gods of beauty are amazing... or rather, a lot of them are really intense...
But maybe... she's not a bad goddess... I think.
t13611: Q: A word for your fans
t13612:
F-fans?!
People who'd call me their "fave"...?
But if they're out there... thank you... thank you so much!!
t13613:
At the very least... I absolutely HATE "Cadmus and the Songstress"!
The evil dragon is way too gross, and it's soooo gloomy.
But you know what? Even a story like that becomes a favorite when a genius performs and sings it. That's the amazing thing about opera.
t13614: Q: Please act out the role of the songstress
t13615:
A divine producer doesn't perform herself.
Guiding the shining stars—my children—into the night sky of the stage... That's my role.
I-it's not like I'm embarrassed or anything, okay?!
t13616:
About that busty little runt of a goddess?
She's one of those virgin goddesses always going on about chastity and other nonsense... but since coming down here and meeting that Bell kid, maybe she's gotten a little better. Hmph.
t13617:
She's... my greatest treasure.
Oh, keep this a secret from her.
Her brilliance is limitless. She needs to shine brighter and brighter... so I can't have her getting a big head.
t13618:
Well, naturally you'd become a fan of me, the hottest, coolest beauty among the goddesses of beauty.
But I'll thank you anyway.
Thanks. Now offer me more and more of your love, won't you?
t13619:
Someone I find cool...
...A few people come to mind.
They were truly dependable, every one of them.
...Excuse me. I have nothing more to say.
t13620:
I cannot forgive familias that defy justice.
Especially those who exploit the weak
only to fulfill their own desires.
...Not that I'm one to talk.
t13621:
My coworker... and my benefactor.
Syr has helped me a great deal.
So I want to help her even more in return.
I intend to repay her with everything I have.
t13623:
It's about Syr and Mr. Cranel.
I think the two of them are very well suited.
I've tried to think of how to support them,
but I find no answer, and feel my own inadequacy.
t13624:
I simply prepare the shop.
I clean the dining room and check the ingredients.
Then, as usual, I search for Syr, who went shopping
hours ago and never came back.
t13625:
If we're talking cute, that's Syr.
But Syr isn't merely cute.
Her smile heals those who see it,
and gives them the energy to keep trying.
t13626:
With strength on that level,
the strength itself would be their defining trait.
I only hope they wield that power not for evil,
but in the name of justice.
t13627:
He'll grow stronger still.
Sooner or later, he'll surpass even me.
My only worry is that his breakneck growth
might lead him to destroy himself.
t13629:
All of Mama Mia's cooking is delicious,
so I like everything... but let's see.
Her pies are especially exquisite.
They're so warm, and delicious.
t13630:
The Benevolent Mistress is always noisy.
By day, Anya and Chloe never stop chattering,
and by night, adventurers enjoy food and drink.
...Rowdy, but not an unpleasant place to be.
t13632:
A festival celebrating the harvest...
I think the spirit of it is very good.
I hear pumpkeens can be used as medicine too.
I hope the harvests stay bountiful.
t13633: Q: A costume you'd like to try next
t13634:
Wearing a pumpkeen on your head,
like the villagers did, would be nice.
Each one's eyes and mouth are slightly different,
which gives them charm. They're adorable.
t13635: Q: About the world outside Orario
t13636:
Orario is a large city, but
when you step outside the city walls and look around,
you realize the world is far bigger still.
t13637: Q: How does the costume feel?
t13638:
It's not made in a way that hinders movement,
so it may be quite practical.
...However, it's a little too cute for me.
I don't think it suits me... What do you think?
t13640:
How sudden. I don't have anything on me right now...
so please come to The Benevolent Mistress.
I'll treat you to a drink or so.
Would that do in place of sweets?
t13641:
It's a custom I find hard to understand.
...But some people draw courage from it

It seems the number of male adventurers

An adorable outfit like this would suit Syr...

t13645:
Lady Demeter...

...What exactly is "youthful romance"...?
t13646:
Syr will be giving chocolate to
Mr. Cranel, so I...

...P-please forget what I just said!
t13647:
Someone who stays with the one they love till the end, obviously.

t13648: A familia...? What need is there for a familia? As long as I have my beloved, I need nothing else, surely?
t13649: Q: Your thoughts on your darling
t13650: Darling... you would never let your eyes wander to another woman, would you? If you ever did, I would... Heh heh.

t13653: Q: A question about your darling 2
t13654: And where do you think you're going? Sigh... It seems you need some education. Sit down right there.
t13655: Q: Where would you like to go swimming?
t13656:
If I'm to bathe, it will be quietly, in a spring deep in the forest.
Beaches and pools overflowing with tourists
are out of the question.
t13657:
Many lechers eye Syr in her swimsuit with impure intentions.
If they go too far... they will need to be punished.
t13659:
That lady donned a swimsuit and showed her skin...

Perhaps it means that elves, too, must change?
t13660:
Observe the suspects closely and corner them, one sure move at a time. I find it a little insulting to be thought bad at this.
...Pardon? I'm not desperate at all.
t13661:
They're dear comrades who've weathered grueling work alongside me every day.
Someday... I'd like all of us, Lunoire and Mama Mia included, to go on vacation together.
t13663:
Led by their captain, Bell, it is a familia where each would risk their very lives for their comrades—inexperienced, but righteous.

t13664:
She saved me when I was smoldering with a thirst for judgment and a sense of loss... and patiently embraced me. She is my benefactor.
I will never forget that debt, no matter what.
t13666: My dear friend, whom I admired and respected above all... Even now, the "justice" she spoke of remains firmly in the depths of my heart.
t13668:
A goddess merciful beyond measure, who would defy even the truth she upholds to protect her followers.
Without Lady Astraea's guidance, I would not be who I am today.
t13670:
Alise and the others taught it to me... and Bell made me realize it.
It is something irreplaceable that has kept circling within me.
t13671:
Ms. Ais, absolutely!
Ms. Ais, by a mile!
There's nobody else who's cool!
In my book, Ms. Ais is number one!
t13672:
If Loki were super normal, maybe?

didn't laze around, and cleaned the home...
...Just thinking about it makes me super worried.
t13673:
Ms. Ais is who I look up to!
I know the gap between us is too big
to close easily, no matter what.
But I'll definitely catch up to her!
t13674:
I think I'll clean up our home today.

t13675:
When a new Jyaga Maru-kun flavor came out,

It hit me again how much she really loves them.
t13676:
Of course! Ms. Ais!
I once gave her some clothes,
and she wore them so cutely... Ahh,
I want to go clothes shopping with her again.
t13677:
Th-that's hard to even imagine...
Maybe... they can cast magic without chanting,
they're fast and strong, with no openings in offense or defense?
...Saying that somehow made me mad.
t13679:
She's a great lady who guides me.
She's teaching me what it means to be a mage.
...Someday I want to become a fine mage
and repay her kindness.
t13681:
I think it's the strongest, proudest
familia in all of Orario.
Its members may be a bit quirky,
but there are lots of seniors worth respecting.
t13682: Q: How to deal with Loki's pranks
t13683:
First, sense Loki's presence.

when I went, it was so much fun!
Maybe it helped that it was women only?
t13685:
This time it was a women-only pool,
so next time it'd be nice if men could come too.
Then the whole Loki Familia
could play and relax together.
t13686:
"Too revealing, absolutely not!"
...is what I thought at first, but
it doesn't show much skin and has cute details,
so I ended up thinking it's not so bad.
t13687: Q: Who would you like to see in a swimsuit?
t13688:
...Ms. Tione and Ms. Tiona, maybe?
Then with Ms. Ais too,
the four of us could've played together...
...Maybe I'll invite them next time.
t13689: Q: Do you like frills and lace?
t13690:
Yes! I love cute things,
so I try to work them into my everyday clothes too!
My swimsuit has them as well.
See, right here? Cute, right? Right?
t13691: Q: Your outfit looks like Bell's?
t13692:
It's a coincidence! We changed gear at the same time,
and they're a little, slightly, barely similar, that's all!
It is absolutely NOT matching outfits,
so don't get the wrong idea! Hmph!
t13693:
I made it while consulting with Lady Riveria,
and it paid off. It fits my body perfectly!
I was particular about the look too,
and it turned out really great!
t13694:
He's a shameless rabbit who's always
staring at Ms. Ais. Honestly...
...Though maybe there's something
to learn from how hard he tries.
t13695:
Ms. Tiona and Ms. Tione keep asking
"How about gear like this?" but...
...um... it all uses so little fabric...
Meager little me could never compare to them...
t13697:
Strong, noble, beautiful...

Even if I can't yet, I want to keep chasing her
so I can be of help to her someday.
t13698: Q: How will you spend New Year's holiday?
t13699: If I could relax, I planned to dive into some reading... but if Ms. Ais wants to go on a trip, that changes everything!
t13700: Q: How do you like the furisode?
t13701:
This is like a Far Eastern dress... right?

t13702: Q: About the New Year Lucky Girl Contest
t13703:
Whaaat!

t13705:
In the Far East, they call the sun rising on New Year's Day the "first sunrise."
Ms. Ais is beautiful and dazzling, just like the first sunrise... She's who I long for.
t13707:
That I can stay by Ms. Ais's side forever.
And... get much, much stronger and show that womanizing pervert rabbit, Bell Cranel, just how far apart we are!
t13708:
The captain, obviously.
...Fine, fine, leave it to me.
I'll tell you again and again so you never forget.
Now, get ready for an all-nighter!
t13709:
The future captain, no doubt.
I mean, who else could it be but the captain?
t13711:
Nothing special, really.

t13713:
Hey, don't you sense the captain nearby?

Heh, the captain is so mischievous.
t13714: Q: Something you want to brag about
t13715:
Heh, I won another negotiation with Amid today.

I'll keep it up and win next time too~
t13716:
The captain, of course. Isn't it obvious?

t13717:
Not hearing the captain's voice, not seeing his smile,

t13719:
I love him.
The captain is the man of destiny who defeated me.
Without him, I wouldn't be who I am today.

t13720: Q: About the weapons you use
t13721:
I just can't settle on a weapon.
Twin blades aren't bad,
but fighting barehanded suits me too...
Hmm, I guess it depends on the situation.
t13722:
I'm thinking of going clothes shopping today.
I'll dress up and keep the captain's eyes all to myself,
and then the two of us will... Ahh!
Don't you think that's a great plan?
t13723:
My darling, obviously?
No, it can only be my darling.
My darling is the coolest in the whole world~♡
t13724:
A familia without my darling is unthinkable.

t13725:
Marry me already!

t13726:
I WON'T FORGIVE my darling for talking about other women!

t13728:
Huh, where I'd like to live with my darling?!

t13729:
Everyone's cute, but hmm...

t13730:
They've trained so hard their boobs turned to muscle!

t13732:

t13734:
My sword's name? Guess what it is!

t13735: Q: Something you want to do lately
t13736:
Ahh, I just wanna move around, y'know?

or fighting strong people... Ngh!

t13737:
Let's see~... Gareth, maybe?
He's strong, tough, takes care of people, strong...
Huh, did I say strong twice?
Eh, whatever, whatever! Ahahaha~!
t13738:
A familia you can't join without big boobs!

I mean, I do my boob exercises really hard

t13740:
Someday I'm gonna be stronger than Gareth~

Strong enough to send Gareth flying!
t13742:
Time for my energetic boob exercises today too!
I'm gonna get bigger than Tione!

t13745: Q: Tell us about your favorite heroic tales

Number one is "Argonaut"!!

t13747:
She's so strong, but super kind!

I love Ais!

Magical girls are amazing!

Because the fairy-tale hero—"Argonaut"—made me laugh so much!

t13762:

maybe even more.

t13763:
What're you lookin' at? I'll knock you out!

...I said quit lookin'! I'll make you run errands!
t13765:
Apparently some brats have been copyin' me.

...Ugh, I'm gettin' pissed! Quit copyin' me!
t13766:

t13767:
Lv. 100! Now that's impressive!

The young pups are standing before me,

t13771:

t13772:
Hmm... I'm not well versed in such matters,

t13773:

Coming back from the Dungeon

t13774:
She's a lazy, slovenly god,

t13775:
Oh, wait right there a moment.

999... 1000! Practice swings complete.

t13776:

t13777:
Meeting strangers and laughing together is good,

That's what makes festivals great.

t13778:
Drink is welcome anytime.

So let's pour for each other and drink on the spot!
I'll be waiting anytime! Ha ha ha!
t13780:
While I'm wearing this outfit,
children keep swarming around me.

Quite amusing! Ha ha ha!

Something that gets my energy up

Giving the young pups weapons or armor

t13785:
Orario has many good-looking people,

t13789:
We've known each other a long time.

Lion is very dependable.
She's someone I'd like to stay in touch with.
t13790:
If no sudden requests come in,

t13792:

t13793:
Objectively, there are many such people,

The conviction still at her core

t13794:

t13795:
I am grateful.

t13796:

I wish I could make a magic item that clones me...
t13799:
My every word exists for Lady Freya.

t13800:
A familia without Lady Freya.
A familia without the goddess

t13801:
She is my everything.
...A little more? Hm, very well.
To me, Lady Freya is...

t13803:
That she keeps me at her side.
There is no greater honor.
My time exists for the goddess.
If need be, I would not spare even my life.
t13804:
I merely offer this body
to the goddess's divine will.
As I always have, and always will.
Now, I have water to fetch. Excuse me.
t13806:
I have kept on tasting the "mud" of defeat... and even now, I loathe this feeble body.
What does a body this frail hope to grasp?
t13808:
The meals Mia made... Those were good.
I am who I am because of that cooking.
t13809:
I must become stronger.
As one granted that lady's favor, I cannot allow myself to stagnate.
t13810: Q: Your thoughts on Lady Freya
t13811:
She gave me a "name"—she gave me everything.
It is only right that I devote all that I am to her.
t13812: Q: Tell us your pride as a warrior
t13813:

If you wish to know... come at me.
t13814:
Normally you'd say first-tier adventurers, right?
Like Ottar, or Finn Deimne.
Gareth Landrock's more the rugged type, I guess.
Personally, nobody in particular.
t13815:
...I'll pass on selfish familias.
Chasing you no matter how far you run,

t13817:
She's just someone who was always around.
She says weird stuff a little—no, a lot—
like "I got a prophecy in a dream~," but she's not a bad girl.
I wish she'd have more confidence in herself.
t13819:
I basically try to avoid anything troublesome.

They boldly take on troublesome stuff...
I could never copy that.
t13820:
I hear Finn Deimne's command is amazing,

If I ever get the chance, I'd like to learn from it.
Not that we'll ever team up, though.
t13821:
The whole village celebrating together is fun.

and even lend them to us.
It's a surprisingly generous festival.
t13822:
Well... there's nothing in particular, but...
matching with Cassandra, maybe?
The shop staff were all matching,
and I thought that kind of thing might be nice.
t13823:
Yeah, it wasn't bad.

I never expected it to shake that much... My back hurts.
t13824:
It looks like it's all about style,

t13825:
Treats or tricks, was it?

t13826:
Going by popularity, it'd have to be Lady Ais.

t13827:
Solid skill backed by experience, and vast knowledge.

...I didn't need to answer that seriously?

t13828:
She forgave Lili, together with Mr. Bell.

t13830:

t13832:
Mr. Bell was being kind to women again...

Lili feels just a little sorry for Lady Hestia.
t13833:
It has to be M-Mr. Bell.

t13834:
Lots of people who won't listen, maybe?
Yes, like Mr. Welf!

t13835:
The strength, kindness, and nobility
to accept everything about filthy little Lili...
Mr. Bell is Lili's light.

t13837:
There's a one-day-only sale?!

Frugality is an adventurer's iron rule!
t13839:
Women really do love Mr. Bell.

Lili has to go stop this!
Lili's going to search the area!
t13840:
Lili thinks it's a very nice facility.

is too much of an honor... So!

t13841:
Lili wanted to play with Mr. Bell more...

t13842:
Lili wanted to give off a more grown-up,

t13844:
Lady Hestia in a swimsuit...

a killing... no, two killings, Lili's sure of it!

t13846:
You're asking Lili that...?

...Lili feels a rude stare at her chest!
Lili's older than Mr. Bell, you know!
t13847:
D-do I have to answer?

t13848:
Wh-what? A familia I'd hate?

...No way, no way, absolutely no way~!
t13850:
Daphne is really dependable.

t13851: Q: What was it like to hold Bell?
t13852:
What Mr. Bell was like to hold... Wait, what?!
I-I-I-I didn't hold him like that!
During the War Game I was desperate... so...
...He was surprisingly solid.
t13854:
Ugh, nobody believed me again...
Even when the things I saw in my dream really happen,
they just won't believe me...
Is it because I'm such a little shrimp...?
t13855:
It's a bit of an unusual festival, isn't it?
I heard it's something like a harvest festival.
Everyone's having fun, and the mood is nice...
Though the costumes aren't for everyone... ahaha.
t13856:
I-if possible, something less revealing...
Like Daphne's costume,
something kind of... cross-dressing-ish might be good...
W-would that be too weird...?
t13857:
Getting a little away from busy Orario,
listening to birds chirp as the carriage rocked,
chatting with Daphne...
It was so refreshing. I'm glad we went.
t13858:
Um... it's actually not that bad.
It might look a bit ragged,
but it's surprisingly sturdy and soft to the touch...
If only it were less revealing...
t13859:
Wh-whaaat?! All of a sudden?!
If I don't have sweets... it's a trick?!
I-I'll look for some right away,
so please spare me the trick~!
t13860: Q: What would you do if you struck it rich?
t13861:
After settling all our bills, Lili would save every last bit!
Then Lili would have to keep an eye on Lady Hestia
so she doesn't waste it.
t13862:
It's certainly lively,
but it seems some shady types are gathering too.
Lili will keep her eyes peeled
and protect Mr. Bell!
t13863:
They say travel brings men and women closer...
Maybe Lili and Mr. Bell will... Tee-hee.
It'd be nice if something good happened!
t13864:
A first-class god of concern who clings to
Mr. Bell at every opportunity!
Why are gods always so...
so eccentric?!
t13865:
Someone always shining and sparkling,
who saved Lili...
That'd be Mr. Bell, but pure-white Mr. Bell
doesn't really feel golden.
Hmm... Maybe golden-haired Mr. Finn?
t13866:
Counting on potential, how about Bell Cranel?
He's still more pathetic than not,
but that manly look he flashes now and then... I like it.
I'd love to eat him up someday.
t13867:
A pacifist familia that doesn't even fight?
No way I could do that.
Fighting is essential to me.
I couldn't live without it.
t13869:
She's like a little sister who needs looking after.
She's weak and a crybaby,
but she puts on a brave face.
She still needs me around, for a while at least.
t13871:
Any male who can keep me entertained
is fine by me, really.
One who can go toe-to-toe with me
and not die gets a passing grade, I'd say.
t13872:
I think I'll dive into the Dungeon today.
If I don't fight now and then,
I'll get rusty. Gotta go while I can.
Want to tag along?
t13873:
Let's see... I've never thought about it, but
there's something appealing about how single-mindedly Lefiya pursues what she wants to become.
Heh... No, it's just that I find it a little funny that I'd think so.
t13874:
I'd hate a familia that goes far away
and leaves someone behind.
The one left behind would keep blaming themselves
and agonizing forever.
t13876:
Aside from the times he goes mad over wine,
he is a more admirable god than anyone.
I know he cared for me more than anyone
and wanted to make things better for me.
t13877: Q: What do you want to do right now?
t13878:
I hear the Jyaga Maru-kun
a certain god fries are delicious.
I'd like to try them with Lefiya sometime.
Do you think she'd come with me?
t13880:
I only cooperated temporarily because Lord Dionysus told me to.
...But with Lefiya, I do want to stay involved as a friend from now on.
t13881:
Everyone at The Benevolent Mistress is cute, you know?
Ryu, Anya, Chloe, and Lunoire too!
Even Mama Mia has her cute side.
So please be sure to stop by!
t13882:
Hmm, I can't really imagine...
Would someone that strong need lots of nutrition?
Then maybe they'd eat a ton!
Enough to clear out the shop's food in one go.
t13883:
She gets misunderstood a lot.
She seems cold, but she's actually really kindhearted,
always looking out for people and helping them...
She's my best friend, and she's cute when she smiles!
t13884: Q: Something you want to try
t13885:
I want Bell to enjoy my food even more,
so maybe I'll try studying cooking.
I'd like other people's opinions too.
I'll get Ryu and Anya to help me out!
t13886: Q: What you love about The Benevolent Mistress
t13887:
I love the shop at night, so full of energy!
Adventurers recharging for tomorrow,
praising each other for today's hard work...
It makes me want to do my best too!
t13888:
Bell's cool, but
Mama Mia is cool too!
Even when drunk adventurers start a brawl,
one roar from Mama Mia and they settle right down!
t13889:
Maybe if the person you love is in another familia?
It'd be lonely, like a long-distance relationship.
Oh, but they say obstacles fan the flames,
so maybe it'd actually be a good thing!
t13890:
Before I know it, my eyes are following him.
Even in a crowd, he's the first one I look for.
It's been that way since we first met.
I only have eyes for Bell. Just kidding!
t13891:
Lately my lunches have all been the same.
Bell will get bored if it's always the same,
so I want to shake things up big time.
Maybe I'll use some unusual ingredients~
